summary:
The trends category is the engine right now — all four ratings sit at HOT +5.6pts on trends over the last 14 days (107-67, 61%, n=174), riding a 5-game win streak across R1, R2 and R3 simultaneously. SP is running even hotter for R1 and R2 at +8.8pts (106-68, 61%), while bullpen_fatigue remains the one category to fade across the board, sitting 43% over the last 14 days against a 46% season mark. R3 is the strongest overall rating right now — 68% hit rate on strong plays over 14 days (53-25, +32.0u) and a season-best +63.0u — with R4's small-sample 66% (39-20, +22.0u) also worth weighting when it aligns with the pack. Trends+runs remains the best category combo at 57.2% (291-218, n=509), and trends+sp isn't far behind at 57.0%.

Today's board leans heavily on full four-rating consensus, which is exactly the environment where that hot trends signal compounds. COL @ ATL is the top target — all four ratings clustered tight around +3.0, and ATL fits the profile of teams that reward being liked (though not on today's leader list, the consensus strength here mirrors BOS/TBR-caliber convictions). TEX @ MIL is the second-strongest lean (+2.39 to +2.72 across the board), and MIL himself is a proven team-when-liked play at 66% (31-16, n=47) with strong-play backing at 70% (+13.0u) — a clean stack of model agreement and team trend. On the fade side, CHW @ MIN offers the board's most unanimous negative read (-1.97 to -2.57 on CHW), and LAD @ DET is notable since LAD is normally a strong team-when-liked name (68%, +18.0u) but today the model is fading them on the road against Detroit, a signal worth respecting given how tight R1-R4 agree (-1.89 to -2.11). BOS @ NYY is the outlier to watch — consensus leans away from Boston despite BOS being the model's best team-when-liked play all season at 79% (34-9, +17.0u strong), so this is the one spot where recent trend and season-long team strength are pulling in opposite directions; treat as a smaller stake or pass. HOU @ NYM is the lone split slate game (R1-R3 NYM, R4 HOU) — skip it, no signal to lean on.
